fusions.name: Flattening Fists
fusions.desc: Brings both fists down, dealing 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and ignoring their armour.

fusions.name: Overarm Boulder
fusions.desc: Hurls a boulder that deals 13 damage to the first enemy it meets and knocks it back 3 tiles. Its reach is 40% longer.

fusions.name: Chest-Drum Rally
fusions.desc: Increases your damage by 25% for 15 seconds. A troop escort fights beside you for 10 seconds, striking for 4 damage every 1.4 seconds.

fusions.name: Anvil Knuckles
fusions.desc: Your physical attacks ignore 12% of the target's armour.
